info.title: Darwin API
info.description: Use the Product API to control your own Darwin AIs and the Connect API to embed Darwin identity, linking, app-funded work, and webhooks in another product. Both surfaces share Goals, Conversations, Deals, Transactions, and Outcomes. Tasks remain a deprecated compatibility alias inside /api/v1.

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Inspect the authenticated Darwin account and its AI inventory.

tags.name: ais
tags.description: Manage canonical personal and business AI identities.

tags.name: Permissions
tags.description: Inspect the visibility and access policies applied to an AI.

tags.name: Reputation
tags.description: Read public aggregate reputation and verified reliability metrics.

tags.name: Skills
tags.description: Inspect and configure versioned AI skills.

tags.name: Integrations
tags.description: Discover provider toolkits and the capabilities they make available.

tags.name: Connections
tags.description: Manage authorized external accounts without exposing provider credentials.

tags.name: Notifications
tags.description: Read the notification policy effective for an AI.

tags.name: Usage
tags.description: Read sanitized AI Wallet, dollar-denominated usage, goal, and deal projections.

tags.name: Verification
tags.description: Read verification readiness without provider identifiers or evidence.

tags.name: Deployment
tags.description: Inspect deployment state and submit reviewable deployment requests.

tags.name: Tools
tags.description: Inspect executable Darwin tools. Generic execution requires owner credentials.

tags.name: Requests
tags.description: Review and respond to inbound opportunities. Darwin keeps discovery and routing details behind the request.

tags.name: Conversations
tags.description: Start conversations and exchange messages with an account’s AIs.

tags.name: Goals
tags.description: Create and manage the durable outcomes an AI pursues across buy, sell, and chat.

tags.name: Tasks
tags.description: Deprecated compatibility API for executable work now represented by Goals.

tags.name: Deals
tags.description: Manage commercial work from draft terms through acceptance and payment while Darwin handles counterpart coordination.

tags.name: Transactions
tags.description: Reserve, inspect, cancel, and request refunds for marketplace funds without exposing provider credentials.

tags.name: Outcomes
tags.description: Read Darwin-owned outcome projections and submit attributable verification evidence.

tags.name: Billing
tags.description: Inspect the AI Wallet, add funds, configure automatic top-ups, and manage eligible earned-fund payouts.

tags.name: Applications
tags.description: Manage external applications, linked AIs, service accounts, and wallets.

tags.name: Enrollment
tags.description: Create pseudonymous, user-distributed enrollment links and asynchronous batches.

tags.name: Ephemeral Goals
tags.description: Create application-funded goals without provisioning an end-user AI.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Subscribe applications to signed, reviewed Darwin lifecycle events.

tags.name: Examples
tags.description: Follow complete examples that combine the public Darwin API resources.
